patches: remove unused torchvision and command-line-parsing config import from ResNet module
replace activation identity test with equality in STN initialization
explicit grid_sample align_corners=True to preserve PyTorch 1.1 behavior
replace legacy integer tensor division by floor division for beam predecessor indexes
allocate decoder state, scores, and beam indices on encoder feature device; preserves CPU float32 behavior and permits explicit CUDA inference

options.preprocessing_note: official demo.py uses 100x32 by default; this evaluator follows the official test-all 256x64 recipe
options.special_token_decoding: stop at EOS; retain PADDING/UNKNOWN token names if predicted before EOS, matching labels2strs
options.confidence_note: beam_search returns placeholder ones; no calibrated sequence confidence is reported
options.warmup: first manifest image once, excluded from sample timings
options.sample_timing: PIL file open excluded; decode, image preprocessing, TPS, encoder and attention decoding included; CUDA synchronized if selected

training.decision: No ASTER fine-tuning; pretrained candidate is weak on both evaluated sources.

limitations: These public data have already been inspected and compared; this is not an independent holdout.
Original Kaggle train/validation/test assignments are unavailable.
Pretraining overlap with evaluation images is not verified.
CPU timings are single-pass reference values with first-image warmup excluded.
Results apply to this pinned PyTorch port/checkpoint, not to all ASTER implementations.
